16	On the action-popup, in the chatlog, we show the chatlog items. The text boxes have 3 icons at the bottom. 
17	
18	For visual representation, we should move those 3 icons outside of the chatbox, so below the box. So we also no longer need to reserve so much room at the bottom of the boxes.
19	## Current state
20	
21	- `ActionConversationMessage` renders each user/assistant message as one colored bubble: Markdown followed by `ActionConversationMessageCommands` (Copy, Split, Save). Bubble means colored, rounded text container.
22	- Command row occupies 28px inside bubble even when invisible. It appears on message hover or keyboard focus within message; devices without hover show it continuously. User messages align right; assistant messages align left; message width is capped at 88%.
23	- `ActionConversationGroupList` is sole production caller of message component; command component is used there and directly in command tests. Event rows have separate Copy-only controls.
24	
25	## Implementation details
26	
27	- In `app/src/components/actions/conversation/messages/action_conversation_message.tsx`, make transparent vertical wrapper contain two siblings: colored Markdown bubble and existing command component below it. Keep `.conversation-message` on wrapper so hover/focus covers both siblings and moving pointer from text to buttons keeps controls visible.
28	- Wrapper retains role-based alignment, 88% maximum width, `minWidth: 0`, and non-shrinking layout. Inner bubble retains background, radius, text padding, Markdown styles, link context, and code-block wrapping. Command row stays inside wrapper's width; user controls align right, assistant controls left. Use theme spacing for small gap between bubble and row.
29	- Keep row in normal document flow and hide through opacity, preserving its height outside bubble. This prevents hover from shifting later messages. Remove command-height reservation from colored bubble; retain ordinary text padding and configured Markdown margins.
30	- Keep `ActionConversationMessageCommands` behavior and status subscription unchanged. Both production components and direct command tests retain existing Copy/Split/Save behavior; no shared helper, service, persistence, identity, event-row, or group-header changes required.
31	- Add message-level regression coverage confirming controls sit outside Markdown bubble and still act on selected message. Reuse existing command tests for disabled states and Save options. During implementation, run affected message/command and transcript rendering tests, app typecheck, and app lint; manually verify layout and hover/focus behavior.
32	
33	## Acceptance criteria
34	
35	- Every user/assistant message shows Copy, Split, Save below colored bubble, outside its background. Bubble encloses text with ordinary padding and no command-height space.
36	- User bubble and controls align right; assistant bubble and controls align left. Hovering either bubble or controls, or focusing any message control, reveals row. Devices without hover show controls continuously. Revealing controls causes no layout shift.
37	- Short messages, long Markdown, code blocks, streaming output, and narrow popup widths keep text and controls readable without overlap or horizontal clipping, in light and dark themes.
38	- Copy still copies exact source Markdown. Split and Save retain current running, read-only, pending, and first-prompt rules; tooltips, accessible labels, menus, dialogs, and error reporting remain intact.
39	- Event Copy controls and collapsed group headers remain unchanged. Focused regression tests, app typecheck, and app lint pass before implementation is submitted.

I added `Current state`, `Implementation details` and `Acceptance criteria` to `design/feature_descriptions/J_59_improve_layout_action_details_on_action_editor.md` and set `status` to `ready for implementation`. Nothing staged or committed.

**What the code shows:**
- Only one file needs to change: `app/src/components/actions/editor/action_definition_fields.tsx`. `ActionEditorContent` is the only place that uses it.
- Current layout:
  - One row with Label, Type, Output kind and Icon.
  - Description, Ask user for and Version question each on their own full-width line below it.
- One existing test will need updating: `shows label, type, and icon before description` in `action_definition_fields.grouped.test.tsx`. It checks that Description comes after Icon, which the new layout changes. The doc covers this update.

**Decisions I made that the card didn't state — please confirm or correct:**
1. **Column widths:** fields in a row split the width equally. So Label and Description are each half width.
2. **Last row when Version question is hidden:** Ask user for keeps half width. Otherwise it would jump between full and half width whenever Version is selected or cleared. This uses two fixed equal grid columns.
3. **Narrow screens:** below the `md` breakpoint (MUI's medium screen width), all fields stack in one column in the new order. Same behavior as the current row.
4. **Alignment:** fields in a row line up at the top, so an error message under one field doesn't push the others out of line.
